tool_args.rationale: The supply-bullwhip bridge maps to the inland-hub siphon. The acquired rows span sink gradients, allowing the inhibition and square-root branch coefficients to be fitted numerically and tested on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired gradient-varying rows resolve the fixed-gradient identifiability ambiguity for the three-parameter static siphon model.
The bridge signature and gradient-dependent observations favor the transferred sink-inhibited siphon; the pilot gives no evidence requiring a memory ODE.
